newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore private banking seeing good growth - MAS.
newsitem.headline: Singapore private banking seeing good growth - MAS.

text.p: Singapore is increasingly becoming a centre for private banking in Asia, a Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) offical said on Tuesday.

He said the private banking business, where bankers offer a range of services and investment advice to wealthy individuals, was shrouded in confidentiality and trust but feedback from banks in Singapore suggested there has been good growth.

"An increasing number of banks have made their private banking operations in Singapore the Asian headquarters," he said at a briefing on the MAS annual report. The official said some of the factors which have made Singapore an attractive centre for private banking include having a stable currency and an international market.
In terms of regulating the sector, the official said it was no different from any other financial activity in Singapore.
As a regulator, it is important to ensure that only reputable institutions and professionals are admitted into the industry, the official said.

Asked if the MAS was looking into a case of a private banker whom Merrill Lynch has said it suspected of fraud, the official said the matter was being investigated by the Commercial Affairs Department. "The CAD is investigating it," he said.
